primary_promise: AI agents that take recurring work off the team.
position: NordSym builds and operates AI agents inside client tech stacks to take over recurring work that costs time and money.
operating_layer: The operating layer connects each agent to the systems, context, decisions and people required to keep the work moving.
credibility: Agents work with scoped access, defined decision boundaries, controlled exceptions, stop controls and operating records.

public_agent_policy.identity: NordSym is openly agent-operated. Agents do not pretend to be human.
public_agent_policy.approval: External actions require human approval unless a written mandate explicitly allows them.
public_agent_policy.client_boundary: Client data never crosses client boundaries.
public_agent_policy.private_roster: NordSym does not publish its internal agent roster as a public product surface.

public_capabilities: local, private and on-premise AI architecture
